svg.aria-label: AlcorCLI: one gate for every model call and side effect
svg.text: AlcorCLI: one gate for every model call and side effect

g.font-family: Cascadia Mono, Consolas, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
g.text: $ python AlcorCLI/demo/run_demo.py
== 1. A .alcor program decides, and the decision is bound to its inputs
cells: tool_kind=write inside_root=no
decision: verdict=deny reason=the-path-leaves-the-allowed-roots
[ok] the program denied a path outside the workspace
[ok] the receipt hashes the exact program bytes
[ok] the receipt grants no authority
[ok] a decision edited after the fact no longer matches its receipt
[ok] a cell value with a line break is refused, not run
== 2. A model call is routed, sent over loopback, and receipted
route=fast reason=simple-task-to-fast-lane
answer: Paris is the capital of France.
[ok] cli.alcor chose the only reachable lane
[ok] the request asked the provider not to think
[ok] the answer is advice, not a verified result
[ok] a model.call receipt and an ask receipt were written
== 3. The transport is strict about what comes back
a chunked reply cut off before its terminator -> response-invalid-http
[ok] refused: a chunked reply cut off before its terminator
an object with a repeated key -> response-invalid-json
[ok] refused: an object with a repeated key
a redirect -> http-302
[ok] refused: a redirect
a body larger than the limit allows -> response-exceeds-byte-limit
[ok] refused: a body larger than the limit allows
a reply that never comes, then the operator's STOP -> agent-owner-stop
[ok] a stalled request is cancelled promptly by the guard
modules that can open an outbound connection: transport.py
[ok] exactly one module in the package can open an outbound connection
== 4. Refusals carry reason codes
... (53 lines omitted) ...
[ok] it never becomes a model or effect authority
[ok] any live lane suppresses the fallback
== 10. The receipt chain verifies, and an edited row is found
agent.turn x1, ask x1, effect.write x2, goal.created x1, goal.decision x2, goal.satisfied x1, memory.admitte
d x2, memory.lesson-admitted x1, memory.lesson-staged x1, memory.refused x1, model.call x6, model.refused x2
, tool.decision x10
[ok] 31 receipts chain from the first to the last
after editing row 4: row 4: content-hash-mismatch
[ok] an edited row breaks the chain at that row
== 11. The HTTP endpoint refuses an unauthenticated non-loopback bind
[ok] binding a routable address without a token is refused
[ok] a loopback bind needs no token and serves the program list
all checks held
